description: This file implements a client-side cache and fetch logic for explore recommendations in a React application, including in-memory and session storage caching, cache invalidation, and request de-duplication.

methods.name: primeExploreRecommendationsPoolCache
methods.description: Seeds the cache with provided recommendations, roles, and metadata for a specific persona and mode.

methods.name: clearExploreRecommendationsPoolCache
methods.description: Clears cached recommendations from memory and session storage, optionally filtered by personaId.

methods.name: getExploreRecommendationsPool
methods.description: Fetches the recommendations pool for a persona, utilizing cache and request de-duplication.
